name: FT BillWillams Trader
summary: This EA trades based on Bill Williams' trading system, utilizing his suite of indicators including Alligator, Awesome Oscillator, Fractals, and Market Facilitation Index to identify momentum-based entry and exit signals. It systematically opens positions when multiple Williams indicators align to confirm trend direction and momentum. The EA applies Bill Williams' five-dimensional market analysis framework for trade decision-making.
summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯交易系统进行交易，利用其指标套件（包括鳄鱼线、动量震荡指标、分形和市场便利指数）来识别基于动量的入场和出场信号。当多个威廉姆斯指标对齐确认趋势方向和动量时，系统性地开仓。该EA应用比尔·威廉姆斯五维市场分析框架进行交易决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的经典交易理论，采用五维市场分析框架进行交易决策。入场条件基于鳄鱼线的三条均线（颚、齿、唇）判断趋势方向，当价格在唇线之上且鳄鱼线向上张开时做多，反之做空。动量震荡指标(AO)和加速震荡指标(AC)用于确认动量方向，当AO和AC同向为正时确认多头动量，同向为负时确认空头动量。分形指标用于确定突破入场点，当价格突破上行分形时触发买入，突破下行分形时触发卖出。出场条件通常基于鳄鱼线交叉或价格回落至颚线时平仓。仓位管理可能基于账户余额的固定比例或固定手数，资金管理方面缺乏详细的风险控制机制说明。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on Bill Williams' classic trading theory, employing a five-dimensional market analysis framework for trade decisions. Entry conditions rely on the Alligator's three moving averages (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to determine trend direction - going long when price is above the Lip line and the Alligator is opening upward, and vice versa for short positions. The Awesome Oscillator (AO) and Accelerator Oscillator (AC) are used to confirm momentum direction, with both positive confirming bullish momentum and both negative confirming bearish momentum. Fractal indicators determine breakout entry points, triggering buys when price breaks above an up fractal and sells when it breaks below a down fractal. Exit conditions are typically based on Alligator line crossovers or when price falls back to the Jaw line. Position sizing may use a fixed percentage of account balance or fixed lots, while money management lacks detailed risk control mechanisms.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points; 0 to disable

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 交易时间周期，0为当前周期

pros: 基于经典的比尔·威廉姆斯交易理论，策略逻辑有深厚的理论基础支撑
多指标协同确认（鳄鱼线+AO+AC+分形），减少虚假信号
五维分析框架提供全面的市场视角，不仅依赖单一指标
pros_en: Based on the well-established Bill Williams trading theory with deep theoretical foundation
Multi-indicator synergy (Alligator + AO + AC + Fractals) reduces false signals
Five-dimensional analysis framework provides comprehensive market perspective rather than relying on a single indicator
cons: 比尔·威廉姆斯指标在震荡市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
默认止损和止盈为0，缺乏基本的风险保护机制
指标参数固定，缺乏自适应市场波动率变化的能力
cons_en: Bill Williams indicators tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses
Default StopLoss and TakeProfit are 0, lacking basic risk protection mechanisms
Fixed indicator parameters lack adaptability to changing market volatility conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
加入动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR或鳄鱼线距离自适应调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter to reduce trading frequency or pause trading during ranging/choppy conditions
Implement dynamic stop-loss and take-profit based on ATR or Alligator line distance for adaptive risk parameters

risk_points: 默认止损止盈均为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓导致过度暴露
震荡市场中鳄鱼线指标频繁交叉可能触发大量无效交易
risk_points_en: Default StopLoss and TakeProfit are both 0, presenting unlimited loss risk
Lacks position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions leading to overexposure
Alligator lines frequently cross in ranging markets, potentially triggering numerous invalid trades
